author: Ari Koslow
title: Romy Gonzalez (shoulder/hip) targeting return Saturday
desc: Romy Gonzalez told reporters he is targeting Saturday against the Yankees for his season debut.
impact: Gonzalez said his hip is fine. He'll continue to play in rehab games through Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rafael Devers expected to be in lineup Tuesday
desc: Rafael Devers is expected to be in the Giants lineup on Tuesday.
impact: Buster Posey said manager Tony Vitello spoke to Devers.  "Everybody has missteps," he said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Webb not expected to be traded
desc: Buster Posey said he's not open to trade offers for Logan Webb.
impact: The Giants are slated to be sellers at this year's trade deadline. It appears that Webb will still remain in San Francisco.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan McMahon dealing with ear-throat infection
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Ryan McMahon has been dealing with an ear-throat infection.
impact: McMahon is not in the lineup on Tuesday. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yordin Chalas to undergo Tommy John surgery
desc: The Diamondbacks say Yordin Chalas will undergo Tommy John surgery.
impact: Chalas left a game on June 3rd, experiencing serious arm pain. He will be sidelined into next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Henderson (back) will go 2 or 3 ups on Sunday
desc: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said Logan Henderson will go 2 or 3 ups on Sunday.
impact: Henderson will begin a rehab assignment on Sunday. He'll be further evaluated after the outing to see how he feels.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Koenig (elbow) could make next appearance in majors
desc: The Brewers say Jared Koenig's next outing may very well be back in the majors.
impact: Brewers manager Pat Murphy said "very soon" on when Koenig returns. His status will need to continue to be monitored.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bobby Witt Jr. (knee) could be available off bench Tuesday
desc: Royals manager Matt Quatraro said he expects Bobby Witt Jr. to be available off the bench on Tuesday against the Rays.
impact: Witt is sitting a fourth straight game due to a low-grade MCL sprain in his right knee. He could be back in the lineup on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ryan (illness) to start Wednesday
desc: Joe Ryan will start Wednesday's series finale against the Dodgers.
impact: Ryan was scratched from his scheduled start on Tuesday due to an illness. He is feeling good enough to start one day later against Shohei Ohtani.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) likely to avoid IL
desc: Kyle Tucker told reporters he is confident he'll be able to avoid the injured list.
impact: Tucker did not go for imaging. He said he's feeling better on Tuesday, but can still feel it a little in his back when he's trying to rotate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) likely to undergo surgery
desc: Royals manager Matt Quatraro told reporters Cole Ragans is likely to undergo surgery.
impact: Ragans will visit another specialist before determining his next steps. It remains unclear if he will pitch again this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jorge Polanco (Achilles) continues baseball activities
desc: Jorge Polanco has continued baseball activities.
impact: Polanco remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Robert Jr. (back) takes BP Tuesday
desc: Luis Robert Jr. took batting practice on Tuesday.
impact: Mets manager Carlos Mendoza said Robert "looked normal" in his full BP session in the cages. He was "symptom free pretty much" and now needs to ramp up in his running progression.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalton Rushing (concussion) not in lineup Tuesday
desc: Dalton Rushing is not in the Dodgers lineup on Tuesday against the Twins.
impact: Rushing passed initial concussion tests on Monday. He remains day-to-day.
